name: SAT>IP Freesat
description: SAT>IP tuner and UK Freesat EPG source for Jellyfin. Scans DVB-S SI tables directly, selects the correct regional bouquet by postcode, and assigns proper Freesat LCNs. No tvheadend required.
overview: SAT>IP tuner + UK Freesat EPG — no tvheadend required

versions.changelog: Add plugin icon. Include meta.json in release zip so Jellyfin 10.9+ registers the plugin. Fix ApiClient.getJSON TypeError on status page. Add DiSEqC port and satellite label per tuner.
